preconditions.description: The length of the string L is between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(substring) for substring in substrings if substrings.count(substring) >= 2)
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the longest substring that appears at least twice in the string s.
